title: MyJewel
tagline: This product aims to offer users to participate in high value market investments by lowering the barrier to entry.
description:
This product aims to offer users to participate in high value market investments by lowering the barrier to entry.
T
hrough the abstraction of accounts, the aim is to reduce the difficulty of managing decentralized applications, for example by distributing profits securely and automatically through smart contracts.
how_its_made:
This product is intended to be developed using Starknet technology, using the native cairo language and SDKs to create the application.

We have also investigated the type of intelligent authentication technology of the partners and have tested the scaffold platform.
